title: Mehr News Agency:
text:
Mehr News Agency:"
"📹 Chaos in the streets of France: Has the nightmare of 1968 returned?"

"🔺The student protests in France, which began with educational demands and protests against the state of schools, have now become one of the most serious challenges for the government of "Sebastian Lecornu.""

"🔺This protest movement, which has spread from the outskirts of Paris to various parts of the country in less than two weeks, has closed or disrupted the activities of hundreds of schools, and in some areas, it has led to clashes between protesters and police forces, as well as arson and vandalism of schools."

"🔺The newspaper "Le Monde" has used a significant expression to describe the current situation, stating that the spread of youth protests has caused "cold sweat" for the government."

"🔺Emmanuel Macron, President of France: "None of these discussions or concerns justify violence.""

"🔺Marine Le Pen, candidate for the presidential election from the right-wing National Rally party: "This is no longer a protest by high school students, but rather riots organized by professional individuals.
